title: GET /latest has no direct route coverage
reasoning: This route has user-visible behavior beyond simple serialization: API-key protection, completed-only filtering, latest ordering, PDF-format decoration through _pdf_enabled, and a 404 path. None of that is directly locked by a linked or discovered pytest test, so regressions in the endpoint contract can ship unnoticed.
recommendation: Add focused FastAPI client tests for /api/digests/latest covering auth, no completed digest, newest completed digest selection, exclusion of non-completed digests, and available_formats under PDF enabled/disabled config.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The feature metadata lists no tests, and an rg search of tests found no references to digests/latest, /latest, get_latest_digest, or No completed digests found.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add tests/test_digests_latest.py with client calls for the 404 case and a mixed set of completed, processing, and failed digests, asserting the newest completed digest response matches DigestRead fields.
minimumFixScope: Add a new focused pytest module or extend an existing digest API test module with /api/digests/latest cases.
